import concurrent.futures, ctypes as c, importlib.util, json, os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'scripts'))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench', 'scripts/native-region-benchmark.py'); b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(b)
from benchmark_support import compare_corpora, write_json
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); root.mkdir(); profile_path=Path(sys.argv[2])
lib=c.CDLL('/tmp/retina-heightmap-candidate/libretina_worldgen.dylib')
lib.retina_initialize.restype=c.c_int
lib.retina_register_profile.argtypes=[c.c_char_p,c.c_uint64,c.POINTER(c.c_uint32)]
lib.retina_generate_region.argtypes=[c.POINTER(b.Request),c.c_char_p,c.c_uint64,c.c_int32,c.c_char_p,c.c_uint64,c.POINTER(b.Report)]
lib.retina_timing_snapshot.argtypes=[c.c_uint32,c.POINTER(b.Snapshot)]
lib.retina_last_error.argtypes=[c.c_void_p,c.c_uint64]
def check(v):
 if v:
  msg=c.create_string_buffer(8192);lib.retina_last_error(msg,len(msg));raise RuntimeError(msg.value.decode())
os.environ['RETINA_INTERPRETER_PRELOAD']='0';os.environ['RETINA_GPU_LIGHTING']='1'
check(lib.retina_initialize());p=json.loads(profile_path.read_text());p['program_execution']='interpreter';raw=json.dumps(p).encode();handle=c.c_uint32();check(lib.retina_register_profile(raw,len(raw),c.byref(handle)))
def generate(item):
 path,x,z=item;encoded=str(path).encode();r=b.Request(123456789,x*32,z*32,-64,384,64,48,.008,handle.value);out=b.Report();start=time.perf_counter();check(lib.retina_generate_region(c.byref(r),encoded,len(encoded),0,b'minecraft:plains',16,c.byref(out)));return (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
os.environ['RETINA_GPU_HEIGHTMAPS']='0';generate((root/'warm.mca',8,8))
results=[]
for batch,mode in enumerate([0,1,1,0]):
 os.environ['RETINA_GPU_HEIGHTMAPS']=str(mode); dest=root/str(batch);dest.mkdir();before=b.Snapshot();check(lib.retina_timing_snapshot(handle,c.byref(before)));start=time.perf_counter()
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as workers: latencies=list(workers.map(generate,[(dest/f'{i}.mca',i-1,batch//2-1) for i in range(3)]))
 wall=time.perf_counter()-start;after=b.Snapshot();check(lib.retina_timing_snapshot(handle,c.byref(after)))
 results.append(dict(batch=batch,gpu_heightmaps=bool(mode),chunks_per_second=3072/wall,region_ms=latencies,stage_ms_region={name:(after.nanos[i]-before.nanos[i])/3e6 for i,name in enumerate(b.STAGES)}))
 print(json.dumps(results[-1]),flush=True)
comparisons=[compare_corpora(root/'0',root/'1',['0','1','2']),compare_corpora(root/'2',root/'3',['0','1','2'])]
write_json(root/'measurements.json',dict(results=results,comparisons=comparisons,profile=str(profile_path),description='Same candidate library/process, alternating CPU/GPU heightmaps; two CPU workers/callers. Distinct coordinates per matched pair.'))
